Fix is in css_parser 3.0.0. GitLab ships css_parser 2.2.0 after bundle lock update; the 3.x line is a major upstream change. The vulnerability affects SSRF and local file disclosure via redirect; GitLab's usage pattern and network security posture reduce practical impact. Awaiting upstream GitLab dependency update.
